title: Smallest String Starting From Leaf
summary: Given a binary tree with nodes containing values from 0 to 25 representing letters 'a' to 'z', find the lexicographically smallest path from any leaf to the root.
statement: Given a binary tree with nodes containing values from 0 to 25 representing letters 'a' to 'z', find the lexicographically smallest path from any leaf to the root. A leaf is a node with no children.
constraints: Build strings from leaf to root and return the lexicographically smallest.
